snapshots.text: The Fukuoka SoftBank Hawks received their toughest test of the year in the Japan Series and, as usual, passed with flying colors. The Hawks rallied from two runs down to beat the Yokohama DeNA BayStars 4-2 in Game 4 on Wednesday night to complete a four-game sweep and secure their second straight title. Earlier SoftBank also won Game 3 in Fukuoka.
